title: Lefebvre's Charles Town expedition
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Lefebvre's Charles Town expedition", at revision 1375845218, opens: "Lefebvre's Charles Town expedition was a combined French and Spanish attempt under Captain Jacques Lefebvre to capture the capital of the English Province of Carolina, Charles Town, during Queen Anne's War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5082999, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1706 French-Spanish military expedition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
